written.myAnswer: The median is the middle value when the data are arranged in order. If there is an even number of values, it is the average of the two middle values.
Mean = sum of all data values ÷ number of data values.
The mode is the value that occurs most frequently in a data set.

The mean is the sum of all values divided by the number of values; it is useful when all values should contribute to the average and there are no extreme outliers. The median is the middle value after ordering the data (or the average of the two middle values for an even-sized set); it is useful when extreme values would distort the mean. The mode is the most frequently occurring value; it is useful for identifying the most common value or category. For example, in 2, 4, 6, the mean and median are both 4, and there is no mode. For incomes such as 20, 25, 30, 35, 200, the median better represents a typical value than the mean. For shoe sizes 6, 7, 7, 8, the mode is 7.
